dialogues.speaker: Eulogy
dialogues.text: "Light-bearer, with your blood, you have paved the road to glory and justice."

dialogues.speaker: Eulogy
dialogues.text: "Even as we hurry on, bruised and battered though we may be, stay awhile and look back upon the world and all its love and hatred."

dialogues.speaker: Eulogy
dialogues.text: "Until it closes its eyes in the depths of night, and a lantern lit for you alone flickers softly into life."
